photo.credit: NASA · Kennedy Space Center · Liquid oxygen being loaded into the SLS core stage. LOX is the dominant oxidiser of orbital launch — every cryogenic stack (hydrolox, kerolox, methalox) needs hundreds of tonnes of it.

see_in_app.context_key: Falcon 9 / Atlas V (kerolox), SLS / Delta IV / Ariane 6 upper / Long March 5 (hydrolox), Starship / Vulcan / Neutron (methalox), older Russian / Chinese / Indian craft (hypergolic UDMH/N2O4)
Interplanetary missions almost all use hypergolic storables for course corrections — the propellant can sit unrefrigerated for years and ignites on contact
